stage: complete base-shape review set; no design selected or live binding
mapping_policy: Candidate IDs are advisory snapshot comparisons only. Null is deliberate, not a newly assigned base ID.

assets.name: Surveyor’s Shortsword
assets.cue: Short straight blade, plain guard, wrapped grip
assets.mapping_note: Visual reuse of the companion sword only. Its founder/no-drop base is not a new droppable base.

assets.name: Quarry Hammer
assets.cue: Compact rectangular iron head, thick ash haft
assets.mapping_note: No exact ordinary hammer base in the audited table.

assets.name: Shaft Spear
assets.cue: Long ash shaft, narrow plain iron point
assets.mapping_note: Strong visual match; proposed display name still requires explicit reconciliation.

assets.name: Miner’s Sling
assets.cue: Broad cradle, two separated cords, finger loop and release knot
assets.mapping_note: Ranged base and ammunition rules remain separate design work.

assets.name: Hazel Walking Staff
assets.cue: Natural crooked head and a plain linen grip
assets.mapping_note: New shape, not a replacement for the cracked starting staff; magic rules unassigned.

assets.name: Waxed Work Jerkin
assets.cue: Fitted sleeveless leather and narrow shoulder coverage
assets.mapping_note: Retain the existing fitted jerkin as the light silhouette; waxed finish/name remain a proposed variant.

assets.name: Quilted Work Coat
assets.cue: Padded sleeves, broad quilting and leather elbow patches
assets.mapping_note: Existing quilted_coat art is sleeveless; this new sleeved proposal is not automatically a replacement.

assets.name: Riveted Mining Coat
assets.cue: Broad shoulders, large riveted iron plates over thick cloth
assets.mapping_note: No exact heavy mine-coat base in the audited table.

assets.name: Pit Shield
assets.cue: Round timber shield with iron boss and rim
assets.mapping_note: Round-shield visual candidate only; reconcile Pit Shield with the iron-rimmed buckler base.

assets.name: Survey Cape
assets.cue: Compact hooded waxed cape, stiff angular folds
assets.mapping_note: Short hooded cape differs from the live long cloak; select a variant/name before binding.

assets.name: Prospector’s Satchel
assets.cue: Low leather flap bag, broad looped carrying strap
assets.mapping_note: Existing low bag is a strong reusable silhouette. External tool loops in the written brief are not prominent in this retained design.

assets.name: Notched Falchion
assets.cue: Broad forward-weighted curved blade and asymmetric guard
assets.mapping_note: Possible replacement/variant for the cleaver silhouette; not an approved stable-ID mapping.

assets.name: Gatebreaker Mace
assets.cue: Compact blunt flanged iron head, reinforced short haft
assets.mapping_note: Visually heavier than the existing Light mace name; decide variant/base identity.

assets.name: Garrison Spear
assets.cue: Broad leaf point, reinforced socket and long dark shaft
assets.mapping_note: Leaf-point garrison spear lacks a boar-spear crossbar; mapping remains unresolved.

assets.name: Sentry’s Shortbow
assets.cue: Compact curved bow, readable string and oxblood grip
assets.mapping_note: New ranged shape; base identity and ammunition remain separate.

assets.name: Cinderwood Baton
assets.cue: Short charred wooden baton and a single iron binding
assets.mapping_note: New mage-weapon shape; no spell effects or class rules assigned.

assets.name: Raider’s Leather Vest
assets.cue: Sleeveless diagonal leather panels and offset fastening
assets.mapping_note: No exact asymmetric light vest base in the audited table.

assets.name: Riveted Guard Coat
assets.cue: Padded sleeves and spaced vertical iron strips
assets.mapping_note: A strip-reinforced sleeved coat differs from a studded jerkin; decide base/variant before binding.

assets.name: Garrison Scale Coat
assets.cue: Dense overlapping iron scales and substantial shoulders
assets.mapping_note: Possible heavy variant of the Goblin scale shirt; full sleeves and coat hem are a new proposal.

assets.name: Gate Guard’s Shield

assets.mapping_note: Live goblin_shield is named round; this tall new shape requires explicit base/variant reconciliation.

assets.name: Raider’s Mantle
assets.cue: Short hoodless mantle, split hem and restrained oxblood lining
assets.mapping_note: Mundane mantle visual candidate; no magic or changed cape stats implied.

assets.name: Quartermaster’s Pack
assets.cue: Tall canvas pack, exposed timber rails and tied rolls
assets.mapping_note: Existing frame_pack is region 1 in the audited table. Art reuse does not move its region or create a new pack base.
